title: TriGeoBench: A Multimodal Mathematical Geometry Benchmark with Figures and TikZ
abstract: arXiv:2610.27626v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models show strong vision-language capabilities, yet their geometry-centric reasoning remains insufficiently understood. Existing mathematical benchmarks typically rely on rasterized figures and cover limited geometric knowledge areas and response formats, making it difficult to assess whether models reason over geometric structures or exploit superficial visual patterns. We introduce TriGeoBench, a geometry-centric multimodal benchmark constructed from Chinese middle- and high-school mathematics examinations. TriGeoBench contains 7,000 question-answer pairs and 12,235 geometric figures with TikZ code, spanning plane geometry, solid geometry, analytic geometry, function, and vector geometry across diverse response formats. Each instance forms a {question-answer pair, image, TikZ} triplet: question-answer pairs are stored in LaTeX, images as RGB figures, and TikZ preserves geometric topology, symbolic annotations

translated_title: TriGeoBench：包含图形与TikZ的多模态数学几何基准
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型展现出强大的视觉-语言能力，但其以几何为核心的推理能力仍缺乏充分理解。现有的数学基准通常依赖于栅格化图形，且覆盖的几何知识领域和答案格式有限，因而难以评估模型是在对几何结构进行真正的推理，还是仅仅利用了表面的视觉模式。我们提出了TriGeoBench，一个基于中国初高中数学考试构建的以几何为核心的多模态基准。TriGeoBench包含7,000个问答对和12,235个带有TikZ代码的几何图形，涵盖平面几何、立体几何、解析几何、函数与向量几何等多个领域，并包含多样化的答案格式。每个实例构成一个{问答对、图像、TikZ}三元组：问答对以LaTeX格式存储，图像为RGB图形，而TikZ则完整保留了几何拓扑结构与符号标注。
tldr: 提出了TriGeoBench——一个基于中国初高中数学考试构建的几何多模态基准，包含7,000个问答对和12,235个带TikZ代码的几何图形，覆盖平面、立体、解析、函数与向量几何等多个领域，用于严格评估大模型是真正在几何结构上进行推理，还是仅依赖表面视觉模式。
en_tdlr: We introduce TriGeoBench, a geometry-centric multimodal benchmark built from Chinese middle- and high-school math exams, containing 7,000 QA pairs and 12,235 TikZ-coded geometric figures across diverse geometry domains, enabling rigorous assessment of whether multimodal LLMs truly reason over geometric structures rather than exploit superficial visual patterns.
